subject: maths
question: The present cost of a house is ₹1,23,016. After a year, its cost will increase to ₹1,40,203. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the house is:
solution:
**Given:**

Present cost of the house = ₹1,23,016

Future cost of the house = ₹1,40,203

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{{Increase in cost}}{{Present cost}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Increase in cost = ₹1,40,203 - ₹1,23,016

⇒ Increase in cost = ₹17,187

Percentage Increase = dfrac{17,187}{1,23,016} times 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 13.97

⇒ Rounded off to nearest integer = 14

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
